sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 938 original subjects, 25 sections and 35 literal Rookie marks are retained. Published WWE designations remain separate from teams. All 122 odds rows and three SKU columns remain literal, including five unjoined Chrome Autographs II/repeated-caption rows with no verified roster join. The sheet names SKU formats but no ratio unit; 5:1 remains as printed without a per-pack estimate. Exact approved guide joins include Base Card Autographs Gold /50, the named Inked/Main Stage/Aftermath Purple /25 and Green /5 parallels, three named Gold Rainbow Foilboard 1/1 programs and the first Base Chrome Superfractor 1/1. Guide-only Base Chrome Pearl White /30 and Gold Minted have no published matching odds row; serial limits for other colors are not inferred. Jey Uso and Charlotte Flair/Alexa Bliss examples remain card-specific. Ambiguous Concentration/Gold wording and the rest of the numbering audit remain explicit. The October 16 guide confirms the scheduled October 23 release; the set remains Upcoming. The October 18 Beam Team interview confirms 20 subjects, laser foilboard and one per case; format and case configuration are unspecified, with no per-pack conversion or serial limit.

Exhaustive numbering remains unconfirmed. General introduction Purple /25, Green /5 and Gold Rainbow Foilboard 1/1 wording is not a universal ladder for base, Chrome, autograph, anniversary or insert programs.

The history guide names Concentration before describing three other autograph programs with Purple /25, Green /5 and Gold 1/1. Its Concentration scope and Gold versus Gold Rainbow Foilboard identity remain qualified; no ambiguous joins are selected.

Base Card Autographs II is a separate checklist program; main Base Autograph limits do not propagate to it. Base Chrome Autographs II has three named odds rows but no matching printed checklist roster; two following Orange/Superfractor captions repeat the earlier names without II. All five remain unjoined.
Base Chrome Pearl White /30 and Gold Minted are published guide specifications without matching original odds categories. Gold Minted has no stated serial limit.

Dual Purple /25 is a Charlotte Flair/Alexa Bliss example; Jey Uso 1/1, Rhea Ripley 1/1 and Liv Morgan 1/1 descriptions remain named-card evidence. Black-and-white image design does not establish a parallel identity.
The original SKU headings do not state a ratio unit. Ratios, box configurations and scheduled release-date evidence remain separate.
